validRecordRule: An interview may be counted only when a real eligible participant, valid consent, a real interview date, a named source, an interviewer ID, a supported language and a completed-record status are all present and internally consistent.
invalidRecordRule: AI-generated dialogue, simulated sessions, desk-research statements, staff proxies, second-hand reports and re-used quotes are never interview records.
note: Empty by design: no interview was conducted, so aggregate is 0. A missing interview is not a null result.
